task: Implement keep_nonblank(items). Return the original items whose string form contains at least one non-whitespace character, preserving order and original values.
code:
def keep_nonblank(items):
    return [item for item in items if item]

criteria.text: Exclude empty and whitespace-only strings while preserving nonblank values and their order.

task: Implement split_chunks(items, size). Assume size is a positive integer. Split the list into consecutive chunks of at most size items, retaining the final partial chunk.
code:
def split_chunks(items, size):
    return [items[start:start + size] for start in range(0, len(items), size)]

criteria.text: Return consecutive chunks and preserve every item, including a final partial chunk.

task: Implement positive_values(items). Assume items contains finite real numbers. Return only numbers strictly greater than zero, preserving their order.
code:
def positive_values(items):
    return [value for value in items if value > 0]

criteria.text: Include strictly positive values and exclude zero and negative values without changing order.
